18:30 │ A CONTINUACIÓN: Women's College Basketball
The No. 10 UCLA Bruins visit the Tennessee Lady Volunteers at Food City Center in Knoxville. Tennessee looks to Kennedy Fauntleroy after defeating Radford 102-48, while 5-0 UCLA relies on Sienna Betts after a 96-34 win over Cal Poly.
